text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haa... ha, ha, ha, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I ran... I ran all the way through!!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(That was the fiercest gale I could muster right now...
A truly satisfying gust...!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(It wasn't just about “the wind” after all.
...I was surrounded by so many other things.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (About the one I admire. About Teio-san. About Ruby-san...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, all of it!
It pushes me forward, fills my legs with power—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(It has elevated me into a true wind,
pushing me into that very realm...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ! Ah... Miss Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...That was a splendid run.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Let us meet again on the supreme stage next time.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, good day to you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Miss Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes... Let's definitely do this again next time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Were you watching over me... from somewhere?)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Teio-san—)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, give me a break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Yamanin Zephyr delivered
a magnificent performance in the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And it was shortly after that
when "she" paid a visit to Yamanin Zephyr—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was on a day when a slightly brisk wind
shook the crimson trees.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...I watched it. The Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: How... was it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Geez, give me a break!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...is honestly what I thought, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um.
That's..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean, come on!!
After seeing something like that—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
After being shown running that incredible...
Of course I'm gonna feel frustrated, obviously.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What, I'm just sayin' you're fast, geez.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: They say she's dead serious about surpassing the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "And yet, here I am... wondering what on earth I'm even doing in a place like this."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Of course it's gonna make me
unable to give up!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...*Pant*.
Hey Zephyr, remember what you said?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She said she would conquer three divisions,
something even the "Emperor" she admired couldn't achieve.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So in other words, that's what your so-called "Emperor" once challenged, but failed to claim—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You mean claiming the Tenno Sho (Autumn), right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The sprint race, the Sprinters Stakes.
The mile race, the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And by conquering the medium-distance 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)'...
I shall become the supreme wind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right?
...Actually, you know what?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That Tenno Sho (Autumn) is also the race the 'Emperor' I admire so much failed to win, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
!
...Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Two "Emperors" who raced through the same era—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The "Emperor" who claimed the Triple Crown and seven G1s, and the "Emperor of the Mile" who was said to be unbeatable even by the Emperor himself over a mile...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The first time those two clashed was at the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
but in the end, neither of them
was able to claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Neither of them managed to reach the Autumn Shield.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So that's why.
Let's settle this at the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...And there, it shall be decided.
Which of you will claim the Shield that eluded even the great 'Emperors'—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To see which of us has gained the strength
to surpass the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nishishi, exactly!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—I'll do my best.
I swear I'll heal from this injury and make a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So……
Let's settle this at next year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Yamanin Zephyr
came to the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of conversation she had with Tokai Teio...
I didn't even have to ask; one look at her face told me everything.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
With momentum like this, let's definitely aim for the Mile CS next.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: While the ultimate goal is to win next year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
First, in the sprint and mile divisions,
I must become a supreme, majestic wind.
choice_data_list: Alright, next up is the Mile Championship!
Alright, next up is the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I look forward to training with you.
